releases.notes:
A big beta update: a reusable edit mode for HUDs and screens, a much more capable Item Editor, and a long list of fixes for running two or more MariesLib mods at once.

> Beta release for NeoForge 1.21.1. New developer APIs are marked `@ApiStatus.Experimental` and may still change.

## ✨ Highlights

- **Edit mode for any screen or HUD.** Mods can hand MariesLib their boxes, and players can move and resize them and drag their text, icons and bars, with snapping, handles and size labels. Includes a reusable on/off light switch.
- **Item Editor.** See why an item has the values it does, edit and save a per-item override on the spot, and drag items in from JEI or EMI. It also shows what crafts the item: a recipe grid, a spinning 3D preview of the station, and a slideshow when there's more than one way to make it. Supports Farmer's Delight, Dungeon's Delight and Create machines.
- **New box styling.** Every box gets Glow and Pulse tabs, background/border opacity and shade, a border shadow, Hide Window/Header/Text/Bars toggles, a one-click "Reset This Module", and size snapping to neighbouring boxes.
- **Diminishing returns master switch.** Mods can turn the "same food gives less" system off for every food at once, or give individual items their own curve.

## 🧩 For addon developers

- Profiles: a second copy of the same screen can keep its own layout, colors, opacity and brightness.
- Hub: host an editable layout as a tab, track which tab is open, forward keyboard input, and open color pickers inside wrapped option panels. Plus a reusable "3D preview + info sections" home page.
- Option panels: decimal sliders and buttons whose label shows a live value.
- The Item Editor can host your own rows and whole pages.
- Tracker milestones can be registered through `MarieAPI`; `API.md` now documents which registrations survive `/reload`.
- `sourceExclusionFilter`: your mod's own item exclusions now apply to eating and using items, not just tooltips.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Running several MariesLib mods together:** gains no longer apply several times over, each mod's settings, colors, trackers and respawn rules stay its own, and one mod's defaults no longer leak tooltips and scans onto every item.
- Mod-added profiles, milestones and synergies no longer disappear after repeated `/reload`; datapack tracking profiles and bulk compat mappings now actually load.
- Turning diminishing returns off and back on starts fresh, even across server restarts and for players who were offline.
- Item Editor: saves go to `config/<modid>/item_editor/`, sorted into folders by food group (existing overrides are moved there automatically), and it now works properly alongside JEI and EMI. Saving an unchanged item no longer locks in its auto-detected values.
- Tooltips no longer show values left over from the last multiplayer server you joined.
- Many box fixes: icon size is independent of text size, outlines and glows respect rounded corners and headers, snapping is less sticky, and more.

**Full details:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/MariesLib/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.notes:
This is a big beta. Module boxes get a full look-and-feel overhaul, mods that run side by side get a lot of fixes, and several datapack and API features that never worked now do.

> ⚠️ **Beta.** If your mod builds on MariesLib, read **For addon developers** below. Some UI classes moved into the new `marie-editor` module.

## ✨ Highlights

- **New Glow and Pulse tabs** on every box: text, border and bar glow with color and strength, plus a "breathing" border pulse (Smooth, Heartbeat or Flash) that stays in sync across boxes.
- **More box styling:** background and border opacity and shade, border shadow, header size, and a one-click **Reset This Module** button.
- **More Hide options:** Hide Window, Hide Text, Hide Bars and Hide Header, next to Hide Icons.
- **Size snapping:** resizing a box can snap it to the size of the boxes next to it.
- **New Hub window:** a resizable popup with a sidebar, used by editors such as Nourished's Diet Screen editor.
- **Redesigned color picker:** a round hue/saturation wheel, a brightness slider, saved favorites and hex entry.

## 🐛 Fixes

### Gameplay and multiple mods
- If two or more mods use MarieLib, each mod now uses its own settings for decay, effects, tooltips, thresholds and tracking. Before, the most recently loaded mod's settings applied to all of them.
- Eating or using a source no longer counts its value gains more than once when several mods are installed.
- A mod using the default settings no longer makes other mods' tooltips and value guesses appear on every item.
- Respawning no longer wipes recent-source history for a mod set to keep values on death, and each mod resets to its own starting level.
- Profiles, milestones and synergies added by mods no longer disappear after a second `/reload`.
- Daily, weekly and monthly trackers now reset when you sleep through the night or use `/time`. Periods cut short by moving time backwards record when they actually ended.
- Item tooltips in single-player no longer show value info left over from the last multiplayer server you joined.
- Diminishing returns now count "free bites" correctly.
- Fixed full-screen black flashing on the HUD while eating.

### Boxes and editor
- Icon size no longer follows text size where it shouldn't (Calories, Balance, Recent Meals, Eat More Of).
- Bar rows and legends now respect their own text, icon and bar size sliders and Hide Window.
- Moving boxes no longer feels sticky: they snap only when they're close to another box.
- Glow no longer squares off a box's rounded corners.
- Hub color pickers now work, and a custom title color applies to the sidebar.
- The move outline now covers a box's header, and icon boxes follow their icon.
- Only one size-settings window can be open at a time across all boxes.
- The toolbox scrollbar no longer covers hex values and slider percentages.

### Datapacks and scripts
- `tracking_profiles/*.json` files now load. Before, they were always skipped.
- Compat entries with bulk item-to-value mappings now apply those mappings.
- A runtime tooltip message override now replaces only the message it names, not the whole item's tooltip.
- Mod scans: two scanners with similar names no longer overwrite each other's cached results.
- Removed the unused `mod_compat.json` loader that logged a missing-resource warning on every launch.

## 🧩 For addon developers

- **New module:** `marie-editor`. The layout editor, module settings, scale-config and toolbox systems moved out of `marie-ui`. Add the dependency if you use them.
- **API stability:** every `dev.marie.framework` package is now marked `@Stable`, `@Experimental` or `@Internal`. Value tracking, events and definitions, compat, tag audit and resource sync are Stable. UI, datapack, scanner, command and config systems are Experimental.
- **New in the API:**
  - `MarieAPI.registerTrackerMilestone`: use this instead of `TrackerMilestoneRegistry` directly.
  - `MarieRequestChannel`
  - `MarieModScan`

...

releases.notes:
# MariesLib 0.1.1-beta.5

Large release: reworks the recipe/keyword classification merge to actually let recipe data contest a keyword match, and adds a batch of new generic (domain-agnostic) UI, tracking, sync, and color subsystems that consumer mods like Nourished build on.

## Classification / Scanner

* `RuntimeResolutionMerge` and the scanner's `RecipeInheritanceStage` no longer let a keyword match permanently lock its category  recipe data can now dilute or (for opt-in `contestable_values` categories) outright override it.
* Confidence is computed once over the combined keyword + recipe signal instead of being copied verbatim from the keyword winner, so items with disagreeing names/recipes can now be flagged **UNCERTAIN**.
* `scannerConfidenceSpreadThreshold` default raised from `0f → 0.15f` (was previously dead:  UNCERTAIN flagging never fired at 0).
* `CommunityTagResolutionStage`'s tag directory (`c:foods/...`) is now per-mod configurable via `scanner_spec.json` instead of hardcoded.
* `compositeRatioThreshold` default raised from `0f → 0.5f` — a stray secondary tag no longer silently attaches a second category to an item.
* `SourceClassificationRegistry` overrides now actually reach `SourceRegistry` (they were silently ignored before), and an active override now fully locks out competing tag/API registrations for that item instead of letting them leak through.
* Added a new `calories` field to `source_classifications.json`, with corrected precedence so classifying an item no longer zeroes or miscalculates its calorie total.
* Added `RecipeInheritanceResolver.collectContributions`:  walks the *entire* recipe tree instead of short-circuiting at the first confident match. Fixes the "calzone" bug class where a weak match on an intermediate ingredient hid a stronger match one level down.

## New UI Subsystems (`marie-ui`)

* **Command Center**: pluggable sidebar + card dashboard screen for consumer mods to register content into. Now supports dragging/resizing, clipping/scrolling, and corrected chrome rendering (blur order, sizing, translation key).
* **Notifications**:  generic client-side toast/notification stack above the XP bar, with merge-by-key support.
* **Scale Config Panel**: replaces the old `ContentScaleConfigScreen`. Provides generic per-component text/padding scale adjustment and can be embedded as an overlay instead of requiring a full `Screen`.
* **Edit Mode / Snap Registry** — generalized double-click edit mode and cross-mod magnetic-edge snapping for draggable HUD components.
* **Color System**: `ColorKey` / `ColorDefinition` / `MarieColors` layer connecting `ColorRegistry` overrides to a real defaults/resolve API, plus `withOpacity` / `shade` helpers and a generic Cloth Config color-row widget.
* Added the new `dev.marie.framework.ui.api` facade package, consolidating the public entry points for all of the above.

## Tracking & Sync

* Added a generic tracker/period-history framework (`MarieTracking`) supporting daily, weekly, monthly, and custom periods.
* Added a parallel tracker-milestone system, both with datapack support.
* Added two-tier client sync for trackers:

  * Throttled dirty-flag sweep
  * Full login snapshot
* This fixes previously stale client-side tracker reads.
* Added `MarieResourcesAPI` for generic config/registry synchronization, so mods no longer need to hand-roll their own sync payload/channel.
* Client caches now clear on disconnect (previously they never did).

## Breaking Changes

* `dev.marie.framework.notification.MarieNotifications`, `ui.commandcenter.MarieCommandCenter`, and `ui.edit.EditModeCoordinator` moved to `dev.marie.framework.ui.api`.

  * Old import paths no longer exist.
* Removed `MarieAPI.registerTracker`, `incrementTracker`, `getCurrentTrackerValue`, and `getTrackerHistory`.

  * Use `MarieTracking` instead.
* Deleted `ContentScaleConfigScreen` and `ScaleSliderButton`.

  * Use `ScaleConfigPanel` instead.

...

releases.notes:
Scanner signal stages extracted into the `ResolutionStageHandler` cascade shape, `ComponentClassifier` wired into recipe-inheritance fallback, `DeathNutritionBehavior` renamed for domain-agnosticism, a marie-core/marie-ui/marie-commands audit for leftover food/nutrition-specific naming, tooltip message/color customization, excluded-item tooltip handling, a bundled-resource lookup fix, an excluded-items registry, and recipe-inheritance score merging for tagged items.

### Added
- `CommunityTagResolutionStage` / `SuffixResolutionStage` / `KeywordResolutionStage`
- `RespawnValueBehavior` (renamed from `DeathNutritionBehavior`)
- `TooltipMessageRegistry` / `TooltipColorRegistry`
- `ExcludedItemsRegistry`, wired into `MarieBootstrap`
- `DoubleClickRecognizer`, `ComponentState.contentScale`, new `DraggableResizable` constructor overload

### Changed
- Several internal file splits (`MarieAPI`, `RuntimeResolver`, `ItemClassifier`, `ClassificationTraceFormatter`) — no public API changes
- `MarieTooltipHelper` moved packages (`compat` → `tooltips`)
- `SourceClassificationRegistry` override folder layout changed
- `@ApiStatus` tier corrections for several previously-mislabeled classes

### Fixed
- `SourceClassificationRegistry.parseEntry()` no longer crashes on malformed entries
- Removed unreachable bundled README resources
- Removed dead-code `ExportResolverRegistry`
- `MarieAPI.registerExportResolver` single-arg overload no longer silently no-ops

Full changelog: see `CHANGELOG.md`

## [ MariesLib 0.1.1-beta.3 ] 2026-6-30

Source-pair synergy value buffs, source classification unification, tag-audit and export
command wiring, and player-logout state cleanup for the new synergy tracking.

### Added

- **`MarieAPI.registerConfigValidator(validator)`**: now validates that the `validator`'s
  `modId()` is non-empty and matches a registered mod; throws `IllegalArgumentException` if not
- **`SourcePairSynergy.getValueModifier()` / `getModifierDurationTicks()`** (`@ApiStatus.Stable`),
  with matching `Builder.valueModifier(float)` / `Builder.modifierDurationTicks(int)`: an optional
  temporary value-gain multiplier applied when the pair synergy fires, lasting the given number
  of game ticks
- **`SynergyBuffTracker`** (`tracking`): per-player, per-value-key temporary modifier store keyed
  off `player.level().getGameTime()`; `activate(playerId, valueKey, modifier, expiryTick)` sets a
  buff, `getActiveModifier(playerId, valueKey, currentTick)` reads it back and evicts it in place
  once expired; `clearPlayer(playerId)` drops all buffs for a player
- **`SynergyAbsorptionModifier`** (`tracking`, implements `AbsorptionModifier`): stateless bridge
  that applies `SynergyBuffTracker`'s active modifier during value absorption; registered in
  `MariesLibBootstrap` via `MarieAPI.registerAbsorptionModifier`
- **`SourceApplicationPipeline.clearPlayer(playerId)`**: clears the per-player synergy last-fired
  and value-synergy active-state maps; wired into the existing `PlayerLoggedOutEvent` handler
  (`MarieCommandSupport.onPlayerLoggedOut`) alongside the new `SynergyBuffTracker.clearPlayer`
  call, so synergy state no longer persists in memory after a player disconnects
- **Datapack schema keys** `value_modifier` / `modifier_duration_ticks`
  (`DatapackSchema.KEY_VALUE_MODIFIER` / `KEY_MODIFIER_DURATION_TICKS`) for
  `data/<namespace>/<modid>/source_synergies/<id>.json`, both optional (default `1.0` / `0`)
- **`MarieDataLoader.parseSynergy` / `parseSourcePairSynergy`**: datapack loading for
  `synergies/` and `source_synergies/` is now implemented (previously threw
  `UnsupportedOperationException` and skipped the file)
- **`CommandCapability`** / **`CommandCapabilityRegistry`** (`@ApiStatus.Experimental`):
  consuming-mod-registered command handlers keyed by `(modId, capability)` resource locations,
  via `MarieAPI.registerCommandCapability`
- **`ExportWriter.writeExport(resolverId)`** and **`RegistryExporter`**: runs a registered
  `ExportResolver` over its target registry and writes
  `config/<modid>/<resolverId>_export.json`; wired into `/marieslib dump <resolverId>` /
  `/marie dump <resolverId>`
- **`TagAuditReportWriter`**: writes a full `TagReport` (from `TagScanner.scan`) to disk; wired
  into a new `/marieslib audit_tags <modid>` command via `MariesLibCommand.runAuditTags`
- **`MariesLibCommand.runDump` / `runAuditTags`**: command handlers backing the `dump` and
  `audit_tags` subcommands
- **`SourceClassificationRegistry`** rewritten as a full config-backed registry (was previously a
  thin read-only view over `SourceRegistry`): `load()` / `reload()` / `loadFromDatapack()` read
  `config/<modid>/source_classifications.json`, auto-migrating existing
  `source_overrides.json` + `source_values.json` on first run; adds `get(sourceId)`,
  `getOverride(sourceId)`, `getScore(itemId, valueKey)`, and `setOverride(itemId, values, enabled)`
- **`RuntimeResolver` classification trace**: when a live external/scanner override exists for an
  item, a new `EXTERNAL_CLASSIFICATION` trace step is recorded explaining that gameplay uses the
  cached override rather than the live inference result shown below it

### Changed

- **`SourceOverrideRegistry` and `SourceValueRegistry` removed**, merged into the rewritten
  `SourceClassificationRegistry`; `MarieKubeBindings.registerClassification` and
  `MarieLibContext` scanner-score lookups now call `SourceClassificationRegistry` directly

...
